title: Beat the Heat
description:
Beat the Heat unfolds through a four‑phase turn system — explore, collect, prevent, and adapt — giving players a clear strategic rhythm where every choice will define the shape and future of each biome.

🌎 Explore the terrain each turn to uncover threats and opportunities across each biome.

🌿 Collect resources to sustain your strategy.

🛡️ Reinforce biomes, reduce risks, and prepare for incoming climate pressures.

🔄 Adapt your strategy to shifting conditions and keep the ecosystem balanced and resilient.

👥The community reacts to every choice you make. Protect the ecosystem and they’ll stand behind you; push it into danger and they’ll warn you before things spiral. 

🥵Your decisions shape not only the map, but also how the community guides you through changing climate conditions.

📣 Ignore their voices and you may lose precious resources — but listen closely, and you’ll uncover new paths to resilience.

☀️ Climate seasons reshape the entire map — from harsh droughts to sudden floods. 

🪴Prepare your tiles and reinforce your biomes to endure these shifting conditions, each one challenging your strategy in new ways. 

⌛️Every climate swing is a reminder that adaptation isn’t optional; it’s the only way to survive.

🦅 Unique creatures emerge when you manage to fully balance a biome to its ideal state. 

🕵🏽 Each of these creatures represents a habitat and reflects your achievements in balancing the whole ecosystem.

If you run into any issues or have ideas to make the game even better, we’d love to hear from you. Join our official Discord to share feedback, report problems, or contribute your creative thoughts to the community.
description_short: Manage a living ecosystem built from hex‑based tiles. Explore, collect, prevent, and adapt each turn as your decisions ripple across different interconnected biomes. Keeping the whole system in balance is the key to survival.
